# TASK-142 — Root and admin cannot be created by users

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Browser review follow-up (2026-09-29)

## Intent

Root and admin cannot be created by users: the owner (root) is never granted through the application (role changes, invitations, sign-up, single sign-on, project members); only an owner grants Admin; nobody changes their own role; administrators cannot change or remove other administrators or owners; invitations are re-checked when accepted; refused attempts are audited.

## What it delivers

One policy in `shared/role-policy.ts`, enforced by `api/role-guard.ts` on every path. Tests: `tests/permissions.test.ts` (policy matrix, workspace roles, sign-up, invitations, single sign-on, project members). Behaviour change: an owner can no longer make another owner; a lost owner is restored with `BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL`. The dedicated no-MongoDB test was removed (TASK-136).

## History

- 2026-09-29 — CHG-031 Roles that cannot be escalated, and the specification as an interactive chat (TASK-142, TASK-143, TASK-127)
